text: hey i was just thinking also oh yeah u know if actually even there was a tool that took a 3d vertex space of coordinates, and i could map between coordinates at the and effectively draw out the curve and runs of the bridge in 3d pathing space, that could work pretty well
resolution: Added a 3D Points mode to Path Array: P0 is pinned to the source bay end, every editable XYZ coordinate in authoring u defines a shared bridge-ring boundary, and each adjacent pair defines one run. Boundary frames are reused by both neighbors so point-authored curves stay seam-safe while every generated bay remains independently editable.
